title: Whitechapel murders
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Whitechapel murders", at revision 1381183562, opens: "Eleven women were murdered in or near the impoverished Whitechapel district in the East End of London between 3 April 1888 and 13 February 1891. At various points, some or all of these unsolved murders have been ascribed to the notorious unidentified serial killer known as Jack the Ripper." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1062923, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1880s East End of London serial murders". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
